name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: R2 Existence(blocker_moved) is redundant. The hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) (R1) together with the hard Existence(has_door_key) (R3) already forces blocker_moved, as the compiler's Redundant clue confirms. Remove R2; keep R1, R3, R4, R5, and R6.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) plus hard Existence(has_door_key) captures 'Move the ball away before you take the key'; the soft Absence(key_lost) matches the 'try not to' preference on dropping the key while the door is closed (key_lost already encodes the closed-door condition); the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards'; and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) captures 'Then pick up the box'.
